policies.using: (("current_role"() = ANY (visible_roles)) AND (published_at <= now()) AND ((expires_at IS NULL) OR (expires_at > now())))

policies.with_check:
((id = auth.uid()) AND (role = ( SELECT p.role
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE (p.id = auth.uid()))) AND (is_public = ( SELECT p.is_public
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE (p.id = auth.uid()))) AND (department = ( SELECT p.department
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE (p.id = auth.uid()))) AND (display_order = ( SELECT p.display_order
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE (p.id = auth.uid()))) AND (email = ( SELECT p.email
   FROM profiles p
  WHERE (p.id = auth.uid()))))
